### Orion Automatic Watch (NMW-WT-501)
Self-winding mechanical watch with a stainless-steel case and a sapphire-coated glass. Water resistance: 50 metres. Price: PKR 18,500.

## Procedure 4: Watch Warranty Claims
1. Ask the customer to bring the watch with the receipt and warranty card to the Lahore main store.
2. The manager inspects the watch for signs of misuse or water damage.
3. Accepted watches are sent to the authorised service partner. Repairs usually take 10 to 14 working days.
4. The customer is called when the watch is ready for collection.
The Rawalpindi branch can accept watches for a warranty claim and forward them to Lahore.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Can I order on WhatsApp?
Yes. Send your order to 0300-5550142 with the product code, size, colour, and address.

Q: Which shoe size should I choose for Chelsea boots?
If you are between two sizes, choose the larger one.

Q: Do you sell shalwar qameez in children's sizes?
No. Niaz Men's Wear sells men's sizes only.

Q: How do I care for suede boots?
Keep them dry, brush them with a suede brush, and use a protector spray. Do not wash them.

Q: Can I buy a watch and a pair of shoes together and get free delivery?
Free delivery depends on the order total. The total must meet the minimum stated in the current policy.

Q: Is the Orion Automatic watch suitable for swimming?
No. It has a water resistance of 50 metres, which protects against splashes and short immersion, but we do not recommend swimming or showering with it.

Q: Can I pick up my online order from the store?
Yes. Orders can be picked up from the Lahore main store during opening hours, and no delivery fee is charged.

## 5. Warranty
5.1 Watches have a 12-month warranty from the purchase date against manufacturing defects.
5.2 Shoes and sandals have a 30-day warranty on sole and stitching defects.
5.3 The warranty does not cover water damage beyond the stated water resistance, accidental damage, or normal wear.

## Additional Services
- Custom stitching: described above (PKR 7,500 per suit, 5 working days).
- Rush stitching: completion in 48 hours for an extra PKR 1,500 per suit.
- Shalwar length alteration: hemming of purchased trousers or shalwar is done free of charge while you wait.
- Wedding bulk orders: a discount of 8% is offered on orders of 10 or more shalwar qameez suits (ready-made or custom-stitched) placed at the same time.

## 2. Exceptions to the Return Rules
2.1 Custom-stitched shalwar qameez cannot be returned or exchanged because they are made to individual measurements. The only exception is a stitching or fabric defect, which must be reported within 48 hours of receiving the order. The suit will then be corrected or re-made at no cost.
2.2 Watches can be returned within 7 days only if the box seal is unbroken and the watch has not been worn. Once the seal is opened, a watch can only be handled through the warranty (Section 5).
2.3 Clearance items (marked "Clearance" on the tag) can be exchanged within 7 days but cannot be refunded.

### Custom-Stitched Shalwar Qameez (NMW-SQ-403)
Made to your measurements in our Lahore workshop using fabric chosen from our collection. Price: PKR 7,500 per suit. Standard stitching time is 5 working days. See the Operations document for the measurement and advance payment procedure.

## Procedure 2: Custom-Stitched Orders
1. Choose the fabric from our collection.
2. Take the customer's measurements (chest, shoulder, sleeve length, qameez length, shalwar length, waist, and neck) at the store, or accept measurements sent by a customer who already has a measurement card on file.
3. Collect the 50% advance (PKR 3,750 for one standard suit).
4. The tailor completes the suit in 5 working days, or in 48 hours if the customer pays the rush fee.
5. The customer pays the remaining balance on pickup or delivery.
Rush orders are not accepted during the last 3 days before Eid.

## 3. Delivery
3.1 Delivery fee: PKR 250 per order.
3.2 Delivery is free for orders of PKR 5,000 or more (the total after any discounts).
3.3 Delivery time: 2 working days in Lahore and Rawalpindi; 3 to 5 working days to other cities in Pakistan.
3.4 Custom-stitched items are delivered after the stitching time ends.
